Definition: from G2232; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.
BiblicalUsage: Hegemonia is a government, a term of office, and it appears once, in Luke's dating of John's ministry. In Luke 3:1 it is the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and the verse fixes the preaching of John to a year the whole world could check.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the reign is named so that no one can call the gospel a legend: it began in a dated year, under a dated ruler, in a real province.
